verdict.rationale: SerpApi is an API service, so a downloadable machine-readable spec is a fair question, but the probe found no OpenAPI/Swagger document at any candidate path (openapi.json, swagger.json, /api/openapi.json, /.well-known/openapi.json all 404). The llms.txt index and per-API markdown docs are LLM-friendly documentation, not a formal machine-readable API schema, so they are adjacent features and earn no credit. The MCP server is likewise a different capability.
